# Local study of the OPS Skills: generated tables

Generated by `npm run study:report` from the records under `results/runs/`. Protocol: [`../protocol.md`](../protocol.md). Amendments: [`../amendments.md`](../amendments.md).

Every required comparison has an admissible, scored observation in both conditions.

## Admissible observations

Effective score out of 100 (raw score in brackets when a hard failure set the effective score to zero). A case passes at 80 or more without a hard failure. ↻ marks a corrective rerun: the case was executed again after its oracle was repaired. ⏱ marks a run stopped at its time limit.

| Case | Track | Kind | WITHOUT_SKILLS | INITIAL_SKILLS | Δ final − baseline |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| C1 Convert a fully specified prose request into an OPS prompt | authoring | development | 100 ↻ | 100 | 0 |
| C2 Improve and convert a legacy, deficient prompt into the OPS contract | authoring | development | 100 | 100 | 0 |
| C3 Plan a frozen OPS prompt for a nested workspace, plan only | execution | development | 90 ↻ | 100 | +10 |
| C4 Execute a frozen OPS prompt against a deterministic bug | execution | development | 90 ↻ | 90 | 0 |
| C5 Resume a frozen OPS prompt from a recorded checkpoint | execution | reserved regression | 100 | 100 | 0 |

Final candidate: `INITIAL_SKILLS`. No refinement was made.

## Attempts set aside

These attempts are kept and are not part of the comparison. "Original grade" is the grade under the oracle frozen before the run. "Diagnostic replay" is the same stored evidence scored with the repaired oracle; it is not an agent run and not an observation.

| Attempt | Original grade | Diagnostic replay | Why it is set aside |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c1-author-basic.a1` | 90 (failed C1-02) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C1-02: the accepted wording of the rounding rule was broadened (changed accepted evidence)). |
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c3-plan-nested.a1` | 80 (failed C3-02, C3-06) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C3-06: phrases are now matched across line breaks (grader implementation error); C3-02: a mention of the other package inside an out-of-scope statement is now accepted (changed accepted evidence)). |
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c4-execute-bugfix.a1` | 90 (failed C4-01) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C4-01: the validator verdict is now read from its own output line instead of the exit status of the tool call (grader implementation error)). |

## Cost

Relative change of the Skills condition against the baseline, per matched admissible pair with observed values. The tolerance was a median of at most +50%. Staying inside the tolerance is not a saving. Token counts are the client's usage record (input, output, cache creation and cache read); cost figures in the records are the client's list-price estimate, not a charge.

### INITIAL_SKILLS

| Measure | Eligible pairs | Median change | Per case |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| elapsedTime | 5 | -4% | C1 -3%, C2 -4%, C3 -20%, C4 -10%, C5 -1% |
| tokensProcessed | 5 | -1% | C1 +72%, C2 -15%, C3 -1%, C4 -3%, C5 +4% |
| outputTokens | 5 | -13% | C1 -13%, C2 -1%, C3 -21%, C4 -13%, C5 -4% |

## Hypotheses

Judged on `INITIAL_SKILLS`, on admissible matched pairs, within this sample only.

| | Hypothesis | Verdict | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | ops-author improves intent preservation, contract validity and actionable verification in authored prompts | **unsupported** | the baseline mean is 100, so a gain of 10 points was not possible on these cases; observed change 0 |
| H2 | ops-execute improves correct planning, scoped implementation and closure of the verify-repair loop | **unsupported** | the baseline mean is 93.3, so a gain of 10 points was not possible on these cases; observed change 3.3 |
| H3 | any observed quality gain has an acceptable cost in time, tokens, tool calls and human intervention | **inconclusive** | no quality gain reached the improvement threshold, so there is no gain whose cost could be judged; the measured overhead is reported as it is |

## Readiness

All five cases pass: true. Mean: 98 (threshold 85). Hard failures: 0. **Ready** by the local thresholds.
